notes:
Summary: mid-market ecommerce SaaS. Product team (Ari, Head of Product) focused on increasing conversion on product lists by improving relevance. Initially attracted to Hosted API for speed; now testing Dedicated for tail latency and predictable throughput. POC details: rerank endpoint exercised — we send top-50 candidate set from their current search, Redwood returns scored 1..100; offline scoring used to tune lambda and features.

Key quotes: "If we can move top-3 conversion by 8-12% without increasing cost by >25%, we're interested in a committed plan." — Ari (product)

POC observations: prefixes/caching reduced token cost on generation-based signals; KV cache warmup important for bursty mobile traffic. Their offline eval harness is in-house (PyTorch/soln), provided 5k labeled queries + priority weights. Want ability to run offline batch scoring (S3 -> rerank batch job) before flipping to online.

Operational asks: SSO/SAML + SCIM integration required for pilot. Audit logs retention 1 year. EU customer subset must have data residency in eu-west-1. Finance: wants line-item for dedicated reserved capacity + overage rates.

Sales notes: prioritize pricing scenario with 99th pct latency targets (<= 220ms for rerank call) and committed QPS tiers. Emphasize Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching/quantization) during pricing conversation.

Attachments: POC plan + security questionnaire in Drive links above. Gmail thread has procurement thread (thread-16283).
use_case_summary: Primary: reranking endpoint to rescore model-provided candidate lists for product search, with offline evals and A/B rollout. Secondary: personalization signals folded into reranker; plan to use offline scoring to vet model changes before pushing live.
requirements: Latency: p99 <= 220ms for rerank endpoint (mobile peak)
Throughput: baseline 150 QPS, burst to 600 QPS (Black Friday style bursts)
Cost sensitivity: mid -> willing to commit if unit economics improve by >=15%
Quality: need evaluation harness for AB and offline scoring (5k labelled queries now, want tooling to expand)
Model preferences: open to Llama-variants and trimmed instruction-tuned rerankers; want transparent performance profiles
offline_scoring_plan: Run nightly batch scoring pipeline: export candidate sets -> run Redwood offline rerank scoring (S3 staging) -> compute NDCG/MRR/CTR deltas against control. Expect throughput ~1M candidate evaluations per night. Will use results to tune thresholds and lambda prior to canary rollout.
commercial_notes: Procurement asks for 12-month committed Dedicated with 2 burst windows per month. Finance asked for example invoice and overage calc. Estimated ARR range provided above. Recommend 3-tier quote: POC credits, 6-month pilot, 12-month committed Dedicated.
final_thoughts: High intent but procurement/security gating. If security questionnaire completes in 2 weeks and POC offline scoring validates expected gains, likely to move to Dedicated evaluation + pricing in May. Close watchers: product (Ari), infra lead (Ken), procurement (Maya).
